Chief_Complaint.content: Patient reports difficulty hearing in the left ear for approximately six weeks.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: I just feel I can't really hear as well as I used to... Uh about six weeks.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The hearing difficulty is unilateral, affecting only the left ear; the right ear is fine.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: the difficulty you've got in hearing, is that both ears or just the left ear? Uh just the left ear, yeah.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient experiences intermittent ringing in the left ear (tinnitus), which can be triggered by TV or music.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I occasionally get like a ringing in my left ear... if I'm watching TV or listen to music or something that'll solve the ringing in the ear.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has had a few episodes of feeling sick and dizzy, described as feeling 'off balance' rather than true room-spinning vertigo.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: there's actually been a few times when I felt kind of a bit sick or a bit dizzy as well... just a little bit kind of off balance.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies any ear pain, discharge from the ear, fever, or itchiness.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: have you had any pain from the ear at all? Uh no my left ear... Any discharge coming out of the ear? No... have you been experiencing any fever? Uh, not specifically... has your ear been itchy at all? (Implied No)

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient had a similar, brief episode about a year ago that only lasted a couple of days.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: I had something maybe, about a year ago, but it only lasted a couple of days

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient does not use cotton buds to clean his ears.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Do you use cotton ball buds to try and clean out wax from your ears? Uh nah I'll do it.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient reports no other significant past medical history.

Family_History.content: No relevant family history was discussed.

Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Uh yeah, uh Jack Smith, uh thirty first October nineteen ninety.

Social_and_Family_History.content: No other social history was discussed.

Assessment.content: The impression is unilateral hearing loss with tinnitus and dizziness, requiring exclusion of impacted ear wax as a first step.
Assessment.source_text: we need to get someone to have a look inside your ear... I'm just exclude the simple things. Simple things might be wax.

Plan_of_Care.content: Arrange a face-to-face GP appointment within the next 4-5 days for an ear examination.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: maybe if we book you in for a face-to-face appointment in one of our clinics... It can be done within the next four, five days or so, OK?

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient was advised to read a patient information leaflet about Tinnitus, a link for which will be provided in the consultation notes.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: I'm going to, uh, put paste the link for a leaflet about Tinnitus, um, in the notes for this appointment.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient will be contacted by the admin team to schedule the appointment.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: you can ring the support team, I'll leave the number in the notes for this appointment. Ring them, and then they'll slot you in, OK?

Follow_up_Information.content: Advised to book another video appointment if any problems arise before the face-to-face clinic.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: If there's any problem, any issues between now and when the clinic appointment is, just book another appointment and you can speak to one of us over video, OK?
